data.title: Context Engineering
data.tagline: Organizing the goals, rules, source material, and latest results an AI receives for each turn
data.learningOutcome: You can keep the current goal and constraints visible, replace repeated records with a summary, and preserve paths to the originals.
data.description: For a long login fix, keep the current error, relevant files, and the rule that shared components cannot change. Repeated logs can become a summary with a path to the original.

learning.assumes: You know a model can receive prompts, chat history, files, and tool results.
learning.outcome: You can keep the current goal and constraints visible, replace repeated records with a summary, and preserve paths to the originals.

explanation.title: Keep current requirements and rule carriers visible
explanation.text: Carry the goal, protected scope, and confirmed decisions into the next turn; project rules files (like AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) preserve conventions across separate chats.

explanation.title: Replace repetition with a summary
explanation.text: Keep new decisions and open questions, but reduce repeated chat and old logs to conclusions that still matter.

explanation.title: Read the original only when needed
explanation.text: Large originals do not need to be resent every turn, but their paths and sources must remain available.

data.boundary: Prompt engineering focuses on writing instructions. Context engineering also manages history, tools, sources, and intermediate results. A larger context window does not choose relevance for you.

lessonPractice.title: A long task contains requirements, approved architecture decisions, dozens of pages of old logs, and repeated tool output. The agent starts missing the newest constraint. How should the next turn be prepared?

options.label: Keep the goal, constraints, architecture decisions, and open issues; compress old logs and retrieve originals by path only when needed
options.feedback: Correct. Critical decisions stay visible, low-signal material is compressed, and locators preserve access to details on demand.

options.label: Insert the entire history and every raw tool result again so no word can be omitted
options.feedback: More material does not mean clearer priorities. Repeated output consumes context and can bury the current constraint.

options.label: Make only the final instruction more forceful and leave all history and tool results unchanged
options.feedback: Wording is only one part. Selecting, compressing, and retrieving the rest of the context also matters.

data.agentPrompt: This task is long, and you have started missing a newly confirmed constraint. Before continuing, prepare a working context with the current goal, protected scope, approved decisions, relevant files, and open issues. List repeated logs and obsolete attempts as material to exclude, while keeping paths for on-demand retrieval. Show me the result for confirmation before proceeding.
